nodes.label: Architecture Brief
nodes.rationale: Captures relevant architecture, constraints, boundaries, invariants, and validation before consequential implementation begins.

nodes.label: Smallest Coherent Design
nodes.rationale: Minimizes new abstractions, dependencies, coupling, migration cost, and operational risk while preserving required behavior.

nodes.label: Change Contract
nodes.rationale: Makes inputs, outputs, state transitions, compatibility, failure behavior, observability, and acceptance tests explicit before editing.

nodes.label: Graphify Locality Guard
nodes.rationale: Prevents local Graphify query, reflection, cache, snapshot, and sidecar data from being committed or pushed while allowing intentional structural graph outputs.

nodes.label: Executable Integration Contract
nodes.rationale: CI should prove that each proposed change integrates safely, reproducibly, and reviewably rather than merely run tests on push.

nodes.label: Fail-Fast Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Cheap deterministic failures should surface before expensive integration, end-to-end, security, and benchmark jobs.

nodes.label: Reproducible CI
nodes.rationale: Pinned toolchains, lockfile-enforced installs, deterministic environments, and build-once artifact promotion reduce environmental drift.

nodes.label: Least-Privilege CI
nodes.rationale: Explicit minimal permissions and isolation of untrusted code protect repository credentials and privileged workflows.

nodes.label: Evidence-Driven Debugging
nodes.rationale: A fix is justified only when evidence links the observed failure to a root cause and validation shows the regression is resolved.

nodes.label: Ranked Hypotheses
nodes.rationale: Hypotheses are ranked by explanatory power and experiment cost, then tested one variable at a time.

nodes.label: Minimal Durable Fix
nodes.rationale: Fixing the violated invariant or responsible boundary avoids downstream symptom patches and unrelated refactoring.

nodes.label: Vertical Slices
nodes.rationale: Narrow end-to-end increments produce testable behavior and validate assumptions earlier than broad horizontal phases.

nodes.label: Context Packet
nodes.rationale: A compact packet gives each chunk only its goal, interfaces, invariants, dependencies, tests, and scope boundaries.

nodes.label: Dependency-Ordered Milestones
nodes.rationale: Sequencing architectural uncertainty and stable contracts before dependent work reduces rollout and review risk.

nodes.label: Bounded Working Set
nodes.rationale: Starting with the smallest plausible set of symbols and files limits context bloat without sacrificing necessary verification.

nodes.label: Evidence-Based Context Expansion
nodes.rationale: The working set expands only when imports, calls, tests, runtime evidence, interfaces, or critical boundaries require it.

nodes.label: Compact Working Summary
nodes.rationale: Replacing obsolete assumptions with a concise current-state summary preserves relevant context across milestones.

nodes.label: Graph Health Check
nodes.rationale: A read-only integrity gate surfaces dangling endpoints, missing endpoints, self-loops, and collapsed edges without making a usable graph unavailable.

nodes.label: Graphify Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Graphify must not invent edges, hide costs or cohesion, skip corpus warnings, or silently visualize oversized graphs.

nodes.label: Deterministic Node IDs
nodes.rationale: Repository-relative path-derived IDs must match AST extraction and remain stable across full builds and incremental updates.

nodes.label: Constrained Query Expansion
nodes.rationale: Queries are expanded only with tokens present in the graph vocabulary to handle terminology, morphology, and language mismatches without inventing search terms.

nodes.label: Whisper Domain Prompt
nodes.rationale: A one-sentence hint derived from corpus god-node labels improves domain-specific transcription without a separate API call.

nodes.label: Replace on Re-Extract
nodes.rationale: Dropping each re-extracted source from the base before merge prevents stale nodes from surviving changed-file updates.

nodes.label: Deleted Source Pruning
nodes.rationale: Prune sources are restricted to genuinely deleted files so changed files are not removed after re-extraction.

nodes.label: Scoped Graph Navigation
nodes.rationale: Focused query, path, explain, and wiki navigation should precede broad report reading or raw source browsing.
